transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Uh… I’m here because I’ve been having a hard time getting near scaffolds or roof edges at work. Even when the rails are up and I know it’s supposed to be safe, my head just keeps telling me I’m about to go over.
Is this fear limited to heights, like scaffolds and roof edges, or do you find yourself feeling similarly anxious in other situations as well?

Mostly heights, yeah. Scaffolds, roof edges, upper platforms… that kind of thing. Even when I can see the rails are there and I know it’s meant to be safe, I still get this feeling like I’m about to go over.

latest_inference.note: This turn supports a specific phobia related to heights, narrowing the candidates to Acrophobia (F40.10), which may include variants like situational or environmental triggers (F40.11, F40.12).
